messages.subject: Lunch bag
messages.text:
Hello, 

 I am just checking in to see if the green coloured lunch bag will be in stock again? Or if it has been discontinued?

 -connor

messages.subject: Re: Lunch bag
messages.text:
Hi Connor,

Thanks for your patience on this one, and sorry for the delay getting back to you.

The green lunch bag is currently out of stock, but it's not discontinued. We don't have a firm restock date to share right now, but the best way to be the first to know when it's back is to sign up for our newsletter at https://lasclay.com/en/pages/newsletter, that's where we announce restocks and new drops first.

In the meantime, the lunch bag is also available in Yellow Amber, Cassonade, and Rose Pastel if any of those work for you: https://lasclay.com/en/products/lunchbag

Warmly,
__
 Gabriel Gouveia 
Co-founder
Lasclay.com
